mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k jobs, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.25% and remains below this level for two consecutive months, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that lowers discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0), supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output signal an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the core consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annually indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL growth above 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 550,000 units annually, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, which drives corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with HOUST above 550.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth rate below 1.5%), the economy is entering a late-cycle phase where corporate earnings growth decelerates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
